title: RO-Crate: the descriptor and datePublished rules, and the two-validator agreement
note: RC1-RC2 the internal validator's RO-Crate 1.1 REQUIRED items (D-2026-106); RC3-RC5 the agreement, not-measured and side-effect rules of the conformance tool. RC8-RC9: the validator's scope -- a crate of nothing, and a checksum outside hasPart. RC10-RC23: what the crate states about its files (AUD-076 to AUD-078) -- every size checked, the checksum exemption the manifest pair's alone, a data entity inside the tree, the builder's sizes and exemptions, and a crate the checks cannot read refused in their words, with its verdict written. RC24-RC25: the documented regeneration order names every generator and ends on the pair, twice (AUD-076).

mutations.name: RC1_conformsTo_unchecked
mutations.find:
if not any(isinstance(c, dict) and str(c.get("@id", "")).startswith(
                "https://w3id.org/ro/crate/1.") for c in conforms):
mutations.rationale: a descriptor naming no specification is valid

mutations.name: RC2_datePublished_unchecked
mutations.rationale: a root without datePublished is valid

mutations.name: RC3_agreement_assumed
mutations.rationale: a disagreement between the validators is reported as agreement

mutations.name: RC4_unmeasured_called_agreement
mutations.rationale: an external validation that did not run is reported as agreement

mutations.name: RC5_judging_overwrites_report
mutations.rationale: judging a broken crate overwrites the committed validation report

mutations.name: RC6_undefined_keys_accepted
mutations.find:
if undefined:
        problems.append(f"keys no context defines: {sorted(undefined)}; the "
mutations.replace:
if False:
        problems.append(f"keys no context defines: {sorted(undefined)}; the "
mutations.rationale: a key no JSON-LD context defines passes the internal validator, which the specification's compacted form forbids and the community validator refuses (D-2026-122)

mutations.name: RC7_any_disagreement_called_internal_stricter
mutations.find: elif name in INTERNAL_STRICTER and not ok_int:
mutations.rationale: every control the community validator accepts and the internal one refuses passes as 'stricter', so a control both must refuse stops being compared at all

mutations.name: RC8_a_crate_of_nothing_validates
mutations.rationale: a crate whose hasPart is empty verifies no checksum and still reads VALID

mutations.name: RC9_a_checksum_nothing_checks_is_accepted
mutations.rationale: an entity carrying a checksum outside hasPart is decoration the validator never reaches

mutations.name: RC10_a_stated_size_is_not_checked
mutations.rationale: a crate stating a size its file does not have validates, as the committed one did with the manifest 370 bytes short (AUD-076)

mutations.name: RC11_any_file_claims_the_manifests_exemption
mutations.rationale: any data entity marked not-embedded goes without a checksum, and a crate exempting every file verifies none (AUD-077)

mutations.name: RC12_a_data_entity_outside_the_tree_is_read
mutations.rationale: the validator hashes the file at any @id, inside the tree or not (AUD-077)

mutations.name: RC13_a_crate_the_checks_cannot_read_is_read
mutations.rationale: a crate with an entity, an @id or a hasPart of the wrong form raises out of the validator (AUD-078)

mutations.name: RC14_a_crate_of_any_depth_is_walked
mutations.rationale: a crate nested past the interpreter's limit raises RecursionError out of the validator (AUD-078)

mutations.name: RC15_unreadable_json_raises
mutations.rationale: metadata that is not JSON raises the parser's error out of the validator (AUD-078)

mutations.name: RC16_an_unreadable_file_raises
mutations.find:
except OSError as exc:
        return [f"data entity {rid} cannot be read: {exc}"]
mutations.replace:
except () as exc:
        return [f"data entity {rid} cannot be read: {exc}"]
mutations.rationale: a data entity naming a directory, or a name too long for the system, raises out of the validator (AUD-078)

mutations.name: RC17_an_early_refusal_writes_no_verdict
mutations.rationale: a crate refused before the checks leaves the last verdict in the report, VALID over a crate just refused (AUD-078)

mutations.name: RC18_a_missing_action_is_unnamed
mutations.rationale: a crate with no CreateAction is refused naming no reason, and its report reads VALID (AUD-078)

mutations.name: RC19_the_builder_states_another_size
mutations.rationale: the crate the builder writes states sizes its files do not have, and the committed crate is not what it writes (AUD-076)

mutations.name: RC20_the_builder_exempts_every_file
mutations.find: ent["sha256"] = NOT_EMBEDDED if rid in NO_EMBED else sha_file(p)
mutations.rationale: the builder writes no checksum for any file (AUD-077)

mutations.name: RC21_the_descriptors_about_read_as_a_mapping
mutations.find:
about = desc.get("about")
        if not (isinstance(about, dict) and about.get("@id") == "./"):
mutations.rationale: a descriptor whose about is a string raises AttributeError out of the validator (AUD-078)

mutations.name: RC22_a_type_holding_an_object_is_hashed
mutations.find:
if not {"File", "Dataset"} & {t for t in types
                                      if isinstance(t, str)}:
mutations.rationale: an @type holding an object raises TypeError out of the validator (AUD-078)

mutations.name: RC23_the_root_description_read_as_text
mutations.rationale: a root description missing or not text raises TypeError out of the validator (AUD-078)

mutations.name: RC24_a_generator_left_out_of_the_documented_order
mutations.find: python tools/model_evidence.py derive          # the scientific models' evidence
mutations.rationale: the regeneration order a contributor follows leaves out a generator that rewrites a tracked file, as it left out three and the ledger (AUD-076)

mutations.name: RC25_the_documented_order_runs_the_pair_once
mutations.find: python ro_crate_tools.py                       # again: the crate states the manifest's size
mutations.rationale: the documented order runs the crate once, and the crate states the manifest's size from before (AUD-076)
